The game CURRENTLY is not worth it, even when it is Early Access and cheap Here are a few reasons: + Low framerate, I have a 3070 TI and I intentionally put it at Low graphic setting and still could not get above 120 FPS + Glitchy, and I mean VERY glitchy environmental interaction + Some in game activities are not properly explained, the Crypt is an example + Unpolished cutscenes and execution animation + Minor stuttering here and there + Lighting/illumination in this game hurts my eyes => Wait for the game to fully developed then you can buy it, I will change my review at full release if there are improvements

1 hour 40 minutes in so far and I am very annoyed. Unskippable cutscenes that happen immediately after a save, so if you die, you have to sit through the same cute scene over and over. Horrible. Just put the cut scene before the save, so I don't have to watch it multiple times, but it's 2025, why are you forcing me to watch this awful story. It makes no sense, the skull isn't funny, AI could easily have written a better story, even though who knows who wrote this. The things your dis-attached head can do, like collect essence are boring, and they don't even target correctly. You will need essence in battle, and you will be staring right at it, but you aren't locked on, so your floating skull won't be able to get it. And in 1 hour and 40 minutes I think I may have leveled up once. I just arbitrarily put resources into something at some point. But it has no effect on game play. I bought this game literally because it's a good looking single player fps. It doesn't look that good when you are playing and the creatures look like someone had bad nightmare in neon colors. The screen is often filled with totally unnecessary npc characters (weird flying neon starfish looking things), and considering the game has performance issues, they don't help anything and should not exist. And that is to say the graphics and style of this game are the best parts of it. It is very colorful. Because did I mention the story line. Black beard sent Davy Jones to the locker and Davy, and his floating skull want revenge. That is the story. Sure. Ok... if the gameplay was great, but the gameplay is repetitive and boring, and I absolutely love fps games. Aim doesn't play a very large part. It's movement, grab essence, use your sword, which is way more powerful than your pistol. Your main weapons is weaker than your melee weapon, yep. You can rapid fire your sword from long range by holding the button for 1 second to release a wave, where as, if you do that with your pistol, your pistol has a 2 minute? or so, cooldown. That means, in a first person shooter, you are shooting laser waves with your sword as your primary fire. Davy Jones skull is way more annoying than claptrap, but the story is way worse than even the worst borderlands game... so far. 1 hour 40 minutes so far. I am going to continue because I want to find out why this game is this price and rated this high, and if I figure it out, I will up date this review. As of now, I would not at all recommend this game AND the developers need to fix the cutscene issue immediately. Forcing me to watch your cutscenes makes me want to get a refund. I KNOW I am not the only person. AT MINIMUM change the save states to being after the cutscenes. And one more thing to the devs, why is it I am 1 hour and 40 minutes into this game and I have yet to figure out the basic game flow of the game. What is the point of any of it, for instance the currency, teeth, why am I this far and don't even get why I need them. Why does it seem like there are multiple paths yet no point to either one. Why don't I know whether there will be weapons to choose from, or is this it? How is so much not explained even though half of my 1 hour and 40 minutes has been unskippable cutscenes. So much I don't understand. I feel like this is the worlds longest, worst tutorial, and maybe the game opens up at some point, but for now, no weapons, no armor, no powers, no abilities to unlock ever other than base kit. What you start with is what I have 1 hour and 40 minutes in. You get mild adjustments to basekit with unlocks, which are negated by the increased difficulty of later game, so you never feel a sense of power. There won't be a vendor selling wares, no cool new weapon, no skin. Oh, and I've died in the same places, stuck behind the same cutscenes, multiple times, so when I say I watched the same cutscenes, I mean 4 or 5 times, each cutscene being 30 or more seconds. So, just in those cut scenes before the beginner bosses I've wasted at least 10 minutes that I should have been able to skip. This game is very much like the absolute worst parts of borderland combined with the worst parts of devil may cry, with the annoyance factor of a souls like, with frequent deaths, but it forces you to rewatch cutscenes over and over after each death. Oh well, if the gameplay changes, I'll update this.

The game has some really fun dialog, and some real pretty graphics, it looks glorious to walk through... BUT. The fighting has a lag behind it, every swing takes a second before it actually swings, a gun that has a very hard to read ammo size, and a checkpoint system that seems to be very random between distances. But the part that gave this a Downvote, a big fat No is the Softlock i had to deal with, Entering a room and suddenly your sword is unable to swing, or your E button no longer working to grab health orbs (Or More Importantly) The Key to continue the game, making me unable to move forward. It needs a few more fixes before i can recommend this game.

质量上相对比较粗糙，但各种小创意很有意思，和自己的脑壳互扇耳光给我整乐了。 战斗部分设计上没什么问题，主角性能很高，武器可远可近，有闪避、弹反、钩爪、处决回血之类的，熟练了打起来很爽；但是可能受限于资源或者技术，实现出来动作还是比较僵硬。（技能树现阶段也很糙，但是白板主角就能打挺爽了） 指引比较差，经常有不知道有什么用的物品，不知道怎么互动的环境，不知道怎么打的机制怪，尽管可以自己摸索，但还是希望可以通过骷髅头给点提示。 优化尚可，怪多的地方还是存在卡顿和闪退（我遇到了1次）。个别地方的中文有机翻痕迹，但不影响整体游玩。总体来说对这个价格属于是包赚，三四十块钱还要什么自行车。

*Early Access day 1 review* I will be brutally honest because this game is really promising and I wish it to succeed. This is a pirate themed FPS adventure with the combat style of Painkiller with a grappling hook (which is kinda Doom Eternal, but Painkiller is closer imo) PROs: - The theme and the mood really hits the pirate spot - Art direction and art style are amazing, hats off - The voice acting (main characters) is very good, it's a joy to listen to the story - Characters well crafted and lovable - The sound (where there is) is top quality - Day 1 price is welcomed, thanks devs! CONs: - The lighting needs a another pass because it doesn't give enough justice to the amazing art (with pitch black areas sometimes) - Performance is okay buuut will definitely need polishing - Combat is terrible, unresponsive, often flow-stopping with terrible balance and not paced difficulty rise. Please hire (another) combat designer, sorry for my harshness - [Currently in EA] The world is lifeless (apart from the art), and needs at least a dedicated game/story designer to fill it up - The overall UX is very "first game we developed"-like, with with often lacking objective direction and situational awareness markers, effects and sounds. You can get lost in the game with no clue what to do next - Game progression stopping bugs, pls fix them, I know you will I'm only giving a positive review, because of the potential this game has but in the current state it really pushes my gamer patience to its limits but I'm still sailing on for the story and characters. Wish the devs good wind to their sails during the development!

Bringing such an inventive look Dave x Jones is absurdbly gorgeous depicting a surreal underworld for pirates. You play as Davy Jones, controlling the body while your severed head tags along giving snarky commentary as the story progresses. The world looks very vivid, it feels like a underwater paradise at times giving some beautiful vistas. Combat wise feels chaotic, you have to keep moving or you will definitely die, make sure to give good use of the finishing move you will be able to perform early in the story by fliping your coin, It will give you extra rewards and heal you, it is a must. I personally really like to all out with my sword and only use the pistol for the heavy attacks. The movement feels good but sometimes not as responsive as I wish it was (combat included feeling clunky) but I did not come across any game breaking moments which is positive in a game that is still in early access stages. Given what the game offers this early it feels totally worth the price it goes for. 看着游戏是FPS类型的，属于自己比较喜欢的游戏类型，加上价格实惠就购买了 但是游玩体验发现了不少问题； 1、游戏画面贴图充斥着“发红”，我是RTX5090移动端，我无论怎么设置画面，只要进入游戏里的场景，就是充斥各种场景贴图发红的问题（我玩其他游戏都没有这种事情） 2、攻击判定逻辑很奇葩，并且处决和钩取的指示非常不明显，对新手玩家非常不友好； 3、故事剧情看不懂，指引也比较差。 4、近战打击感非常一般，尤其枪械打击感非常差。 果然“便宜没好货“，这游戏还有优化完善的空间，目前这种质量状态我只能给差评，尤其画面显示问题，我不知道是不是跟显卡驱动还是显卡驱动有关，总之我玩其他游戏没遇见画面贴图发红的问题，应该就是这个游戏的显示兼容问题了。 ———————— 2025-9-10，50系显卡驱动问题，不支持开启显卡内设置的”各项异向过滤“，需设置为原始的”由3D应用程序决定“，虽游戏有其他多多少少问题，但已转好评表示支持，希望该游戏不断完善。

Davy X Jones features stunning visuals brimming with charisma; frenetic, dynamic gameplay with a brutal presentation reminiscent of Doom Eternal or ULTRAKILL but still maintaining its own personality; a soundtrack, though not unique, that's truly enjoyable and full of personality; and a tone, story, and characters with immense potential and a good amount of charm. I'm truly in love with everything this game presents; I can't wait to see what else it offers, and I definitely won't abandon this ship until it reaches its destination. Genuinely magnificent product.

He unlocks doors and gates and pulls treasure chests out fo the ground but thats it realy. No form of attack or weapons or anything, You get a chicken that hints to where you are meant to go by putting up its beak, but the problem is the beak is hard to see and it doesnt stay up long enough. There are real no indications on the map of where to be or go. The map is dark and some lighting issues. How to improve on this game, in my opinion 1. let the head have a gun shooting out of his left eye socket so he can take out flying enemies. 2. Have a indicator of where the quests is, or even have a better placement for the chicken and its beak. 3. Give us more options with weaponry. STOP FORCING MELEE, so annoying. 4. WARNING: It seems like the game was abandoned by the developers. The last update was in December 2025 and the last communication from them was in March 2026. Since then they are ghosting everyone on Twitter, Discord and Steam Discussion. Due to that - STAY AWAY. Verdict: I would seriously love to recommend the game since I have never seen visuals like this, but it needs a lot more variety and content which we are not going to get. + Positives + + Steam achievements (15) + The world is stunning + Pirates + The opening intro was really neat + Love the soundtrack + You never know what's next + Davy is really funny + Original setting + The fights are actually quite fun, even though you will see them all within the first 2 hours + Treasure hunting + Design of characters + Solid voice acting – Negatives – - No steam trading cards - No weapon variety (you get a sword and a gun, that's it) - No enemy variety (7 enemies) - Enemies have the same faces and since you have to fight them in meele it is quite obvious - Fast traveling is just from certain points to certain points (really limited) - Some unskippable animations take ages (docking ship is like 3 minutes) - Annoying air battles - Fighting flying enemies when you don't have ammo is painful - You get ammo by fighting in meele and yet you need it in certain situations - Grapling hook points are often unresponsive and don't work correctly - You can get easily stuck in textures or even in enemies - No boss variety - I fought the Fire imp like 9 times
